subject: Logic
title: Kelly Criterion
description: A quick, practical guide to Kelly Criterion.

hook.text: A gambler with a proven edge goes broke anyway. Why? He bet too much on each hand.

buildup.text: The Kelly criterion tells you how much to bet when you have a known edge—maximizing long-run growth.

discovery.text: The formula: bet the fraction equal to your edge divided by the odds. Edge of 10%, odds of 1:1, bet 10%.

twist.text: Betting more than Kelly grows wealth on average but dramatically increases the chance of ruin.

climax.text: Even with a guaranteed edge, bet sizing determines whether skill leads to wealth or bankruptcy.

punchline.text: Right bet, wrong size, still broke.

quiz.question: What does the Kelly criterion optimize?
